name: Restic Backups
author: Orien
description: Health, one-click backups, and file restore for the restic jobs you already run, right in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: See backup health, back up now, browse snapshots, and restore files.

schema.label: Jobs override file
schema.description: Optional JSON overrides merged with discovered user systemd jobs.

schema.label: Repository refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: Repository commands use normal restic locking and are deferred while the matching service is active.

schema.label: Failure notifications
schema.description: Notify once when a job fails, falls overdue, or loses its schedule.

schema.label: Restore folder
schema.description: Each restore creates a new folder inside this one.
